mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_selection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.*, u.real_name AS teacher_name FROM course_selection s JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.user_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.select_time DESC, s.selection_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_selection (course_id, user_id, status, select_time, drop_time, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{selectTime}, #{dropTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_selection SET status = 1, select_time = NOW(), drop_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 2 AND is_deleted = 0
